subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should Control UI stop at the current Sessions-page Group by channel behavior, or add first-class separated channel tabs plus a merged all-channel timeline view?
rationale: Current main now covers channel grouping, but the requested merged timeline and separated tab mode require UX, privacy, and Gateway/session semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
options.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and define the separated view, merged timeline, and routing/privacy semantics before implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Enough
options.body: Close the remaining request if maintainers decide the current Group by channel plus per-session chat links is the intended Control UI surface.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining channel-view work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want one broader sessions workspace design to own it.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and define the separated view, merged timeline, and routing/privacy semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle owns the closest current-main implementation and docs update for channel grouping.
